brief: Content production before vs after AI — one writer ships 30 pieces a week.

slots.title: Stop doing
slots.description: One writer now ships 30 pieces a week using AI workflows. Here's the exact before-and-after breakdown.

slots.title: Ideation takes
slots.description: Brainstorming headlines used to burn half a day. Now AI generates angles in minutes.
slots.badText: Staring at blank docs for three hours to find five usable ideas.
slots.goodText: AI scans trends and spits out fifty slants before your coffee cools.

slots.title: Research kills
slots.description: Chasing sources and fact-checking eats entire afternoons. AI agents do it in seconds.
slots.badText: Manually opening thirty tabs and taking notes that never get organized.
slots.goodText: An AI researcher compiles citations, stats, and outlines while you outline the next piece.

slots.title: Drafting used
slots.description: Blank-page syndrome is real. AI gives you a working first draft to refine, not fight.
slots.badText: Typing every sentence from scratch and rewriting the lede eleven times before lunch.
slots.goodText: Generate a full structured draft from a brief, then edit with your voice.

slots.title: Editing is
slots.description: Proofreading and style fixes used to need a second pair of eyes. Not anymore.
slots.badText: Swapping docs with editors and waiting days for tracked changes to return.
slots.goodText: AI grammar, tone, and clarity checks run in real time as you write.

slots.title: Visuals block
slots.description: Waiting on designers for hero images stalls publishing. AI generates visuals on demand.
slots.badText: Briefing designers, waiting in queues, and revising assets for every single post.
slots.goodText: Generate custom images, thumbnails, and carousels from text prompts in seconds.

slots.title: Publish everywhere
slots.description: Manually reformatting for every channel is a chore. AI syndicates with one click.
slots.badText: Copy-pasting into five platforms and tweaking image sizes until midnight strikes.
slots.goodText: One click reformats copy, images, and tags for every channel instantly.

slots.body: Join teams that replaced busywork with AI workflows and turned one writer into a content machine.
